neighbours.label: a connector that opens the consequence or result of what came before (Therefore| , Daher| , through this experience| , enough| to convince)
fire: The bridge was damaged in the storm. Therefore, the road was closed.
Prices rose sharply last year. As a result, sales fell.
Through years of practice, she became a skilled pianist.
The data were incomplete. Consequently, the study was delayed.
He saved enough to buy a small house in the country.
The team lost its best player. Hence, the season ended badly.
Thanks to this training, he gained valuable experience.
The soil was too dry. Thus, the seeds did not sprout.
quiet: The bridge was damaged in the storm and the road was closed.
Prices rose sharply last year and sales fell in the spring.
She practiced for years and played the piano every day.
The data were incomplete and the study was delayed.
He bought a small house in the country last year.
The team lost its best player in the middle of the season.
He attended the training last spring with his colleagues.
The soil was too dry and the seeds did not sprout.

notes: Weak pole (max 11.2), top examples mixed (German 'Daher', 'enough to', commas after an introductory phrase, code 'and'). Probe: 'Therefore,' 0.40, 'Through this experience,' 0.33, plain sentence 0.05.
